The '''Gangster''' was a model of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] produced by [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines]] during the period of galactic history when the [[Eternal Empire]] was the primary galactic power.

==Behind the scenes==
The Roche Gangster was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] Digital Expansion. It is a reward purchasable after building Influence with [[Hylo Visz]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
